prompt:
Create a glossy anime-style resort illustration of a cheerful young anime woman sitting cross-legged on a pale circular poolside platform at a luxury infinity pool during sunset. She has long flowing reddish brown hair with warm rim lighting, golden amber eyes, a bright open smile, and one large red hibiscus flower tucked beside her right temple. She wears a shiny metallic wet-look gold oversized T-shirt that clings to her body, with bold black centered chest text reading Bing Image Creator
DALL·E3
SUPREMACY
FOREVER; make the lettering clean, legible, and printed directly on the shirt. Her hands rest together in front of her ankles, bare feet visible, relaxed friendly pose, no jewelry. The setting is a tropical upscale pool bar: a glowing blue infinity pool fills most of the background, the ocean and orange sun are on the far left horizon, and the sky fades from peach and pink near the sunset to deep navy blue above. Add vivid caustic water reflections, sparkling highlights on the pool surface, and strong golden sunset reflections on the shirt and hair. On the right side include a curved illuminated swim-up bar with exactly 8 upright liquor bottles on the counter and exactly 6 round submerged bar stools in the pool. Add palm trees, small warm lamps, and resort lights in the distance. Use highly detailed Japanese anime rendering, cinematic lighting, saturated colors, polished digital art, sharp focus on the character, shallow depth of field in the background, square composition, no watermark, no extra text besides the shirt print.
